description: This file contains implementation of the SecurityContext class, including methods for access control, token management, and request validation within a plugin framework. It also includes a demonstration of regex usage.

classes.name: SecurityContext
classes.description: A class managing security context, including access control, token handling, and request validation within the plugin framework.

methods.name: SecurityContext::SecurityContext
methods.description: Constructor initializing security context with access control list, payload, and service prefix.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const string& path)
methods.description: Checks if a websocket upgrade is allowed based on the path.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const Web::Request& request)
methods.description: Validates if a request is permitted based on the request path and access control list.

methods.name: SecurityContext::Allowed (const Core::JSONRPC::Message& message)
methods.description: Checks if a JSONRPC message is allowed, logs if blocked.
